lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with higher density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the blob centroids, particularly visible in the mid-section where they form a regular matrix of nodes and connectors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (ectoparasites or commensal fish) located ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
